Above it, additional floors are stacked irregularly as if built by different owners at different times: patched brick walls, salvaged shipping container rooms, metal cages used as balconies, small rooftop shacks made from plywood and billboard panels, solar panels tied down with ropes, and water tanks welded to rusty steel frames. Cluttered external staircases zig-zag along the outside, some made of metal grates, some cement, some obviously reinforced with scavenged rebar. A tangle of power lines and small satellite dishes cling to the facade. Air conditioners, PVC pipes, and improvised drainage tubes stick out in random angles. Clotheslines stretch between structures with drying laundry, neon advertisements flicker weakly, and small window vendors sell cheap snacks from tiny openings. Vegetation grows from cracks--feral grass, moss, vines devouring broken walls. Overall atmosphere: a dense, poor, entrepreneurial living block filled with life, danger, and creative survival. Clean isolated background, ultra-detailed PBR textures for metal, mold, concrete, dust, and peeling paint.
